name: Hot Springs Key
description: (Tag:health-regeneration+)An ornate key that when turned in a large space creates a portal to a 5 km x 5 km x 5 km pocket dimension with a small mountain, natural healing hot springs, bamboo forest, and great view; the mountain cannot be descended. Springs slightly accelerate natural healing and replenish automatically. The exit gate stays open and leads to where the entrance was last opened.
